caption: The video captures a thick stack of white paper resting on the round black grate of an outdoor charcoal grill, green grass around the rim. The burning is already underway: the front edge has curled into dark, flaky black ash bordered by brown scorched margins, while the upper and rear sheets remain flat and white. A thin black wire loops across the right side, and glowing embers flicker below. Orange flames rise and fall along the right edge and top corner, their height shifting frame to frame without a clear advance of the charred front. Thin grey smoke wisps drift upward from the left and around the burning edges. The top sheet and stack outline stay fixed, showing no translation or collapse. The framing drifts slightly, indicating minor camera movement. The fire continues steadily, neither starting nor finishing within view.
